method: git ls-tree -rlz BASELINE; sum tracked blob sizes per tracked path (not .git, untracked files, build outputs or the compressed transport size). Identical Git blob IDs identify duplicate content.

remaining_groups.name: Tatami wallpaper originals
remaining_groups.role: 23 original-resolution runtime images, read by desktop/tatami/wallpapers/package.nix. Exact source URLs, dimensions, hashes and licenses already exist in wallpapers.json and README.md.
remaining_groups.candidate_action: Move originals to immutable, hash-pinned fetched assets while preserving their bytes, licenses and installed paths. This is packaging work, not safe deletion.

remaining_groups.name: Documentation and test-result screenshots
remaining_groups.role: Mixed historical evidence and live README/website assets. nix/site.nix and nix/aizome-site.nix explicitly consume some of these.
remaining_groups.candidate_action: Archive historical captures with immutable links and provenance; supply current site images through pinned assets. Preserve original resolution.

remaining_groups.name: Aizome test PNGs
remaining_groups.role: Visual regression inputs. Package checks execute Yukimi goldens and other tests consume their own images. The Aizome package source includes apps and crates.
remaining_groups.candidate_action: Separate a hash-pinned fixture input or use smaller targeted fixtures where equivalent coverage is demonstrated. Do not remove golden baselines wholesale.

remaining_groups.name: Hotaru top-level oracle fixture JSON
remaining_groups.role: Used by include_str! and runtime test reads in hotaru-core and hotaru-replay.
remaining_groups.candidate_action: Keep for this change. A future fixture-input split must preserve the exact reference data, offline test setup and licenses.

remaining_groups.name: Other retained Hotaru upstream material
remaining_groups.role: Reports, source snapshots, logs, traces, screenshots and other historical experiment evidence remain after removing the 218 compressed captures.
remaining_groups.candidate_action: Audit raw intermediate traces and large reference outputs next. Retain compact reports, original provenance and reproducible fixture inputs.

duplicates.note: Overlaps the groups above. Git already stores identical blobs once, but checked-out/source-archive paths repeat their content.

scope: Only the 218 manifest captures are deleted; other candidates are inventoried, not removed.
No Git history rewrite and no archive exclusions. Existing complete Git clones retain historical blobs.
Root source transfer, unpacking and snapshot hashing can benefit; this is not a measured Nix evaluation speedup.
desktop/aizome/nix/default.nix already filters Hotaru to manifests, crates, resources and simdutf8, with explicit license paths. The removed upstream captures are not package build inputs.
Narrow package filters do not remove files from the root GitHub source archive.
